about: The scheme contract: the colour custom properties every scheme defines for light and dark, what each means, the text/background pairs a scheme must pass, and the thresholds. Read by the kit's build and contrast check (src/lib/contrast.js) and by the dashboard's scheme editor, which checks the same pairs server-side before a scheme saves. 'brand' is the token in meridian-design/brand/tokens.json the brand default scheme takes each property from, one token for both modes or one per mode. Type, spacing, radii and shadows are the brand's and are not in a scheme.

selectors.note: A scheme stylesheet declares its light values on :root, and its dark values twice: once inside a prefers-color-scheme: dark block (mode 'system' on a dark system) and once on :root[data-om-mode="dark"] (mode 'dark'). src/lib/scheme.js renders exactly this; the dashboard renders the same template.

groups.surface: What the page and its panels are drawn on.
groups.line: Borders and dividers. Decorative: they are not held to a ratio (see the README).
groups.accent: Links, focus, selection and the primary action.
groups.semantic: What a colour says: buy and sell, good, danger, warning, and a second category colour.

properties.name: page
properties.meaning: The ground of the page.

properties.name: card
properties.meaning: Panels, cards, dialogs, tables and inputs, on page.

properties.name: hover
properties.meaning: Hover fill for buttons and rows.

properties.name: backdrop
properties.meaning: Behind an open dialog. Translucent.

properties.name: ink
properties.meaning: Body text and headings.

properties.name: ink-soft
properties.meaning: Secondary text: descriptions, cells, metadata, a neutral badge.

properties.name: ink-faint
properties.meaning: Tertiary text: captions, hints, timestamps, table heads. Never on hover.

properties.name: line
properties.meaning: Borders of cards, inputs and table heads.

properties.name: line-soft
properties.meaning: Row dividers inside a card; the neutral badge's fill.

properties.name: accent
properties.meaning: Links, focus rings, the selected tab, chart's first series, selected states.

properties.name: accent-wash
properties.meaning: Tinted fill behind accent text or ink: selected rows, accent badges, the info notice.

properties.name: accent-ink
properties.meaning: Text on an accent fill (a selected segment, a count on accent).

properties.name: primary
properties.meaning: The primary button's fill.

properties.name: primary-ink
properties.meaning: Text on the primary button.

properties.name: buy
properties.meaning: A buy, a gain, a positive change, as text or a chart series.

properties.name: buy-wash
properties.meaning: Fill behind buy text. May be translucent: seen over card.

properties.name: sell
properties.meaning: A sell, a loss, a negative change, as text or a chart series.

properties.name: sell-wash
properties.meaning: Fill behind sell text. May be translucent: seen over card.

properties.name: good
properties.meaning: Success, healthy, current.

properties.name: good-wash
properties.meaning: Fill behind good text.

properties.name: danger
properties.meaning: Errors and destructive actions.

properties.name: danger-wash
properties.meaning: Fill behind danger text: error notices, the danger button, bad badges.

properties.name: warn-ink
properties.meaning: Warnings and things needing attention.

properties.name: warn-wash
properties.meaning: Fill behind warning text.

properties.name: violet
properties.meaning: A second category colour: special roles, informational badges.

properties.name: violet-wash
properties.meaning: Fill behind violet text.

a loss or a sell in a grid cell

good and danger must stay distinguishable
